auctions_by_year.csv.land_auctions_listed: land plots JDA listed as sold at its auctions that year
auctions_by_year.csv.value_inr_cr: total of area times winning rate for those plots, in rupees crore
auctions_by_year.csv.area_ha: total area of those plots, in hectares
auctions_by_year.csv.median_area_sqm: the middle plot size that year, in sq m (half the plots were smaller, half larger)
auctions_by_year.csv.share_residential: share of the plots that were residential (0 to 1)
auctions_by_year.csv.share_commercial: share that were commercial (shop) plots (0 to 1)
auctions_by_year.csv.share_mixed: share that were mixed-use plots (0 to 1)
auctions_by_year.csv.share_shop_sites: share that were small shop sites of 5-25 sq m (0 to 1)
auctions_by_year.csv.e_auction_share: share sold by online auction rather than in a hall (0 to 1)
auctions_by_year.csv.reauction_share: share that were plots JDA had auctioned before and sold again (0 to 1)

circle_rate_commercial_to_residential_by.office: sub-registrar office (the government registration office for the area)
circle_rate_commercial_to_residential_by.corridor: the part of Jaipur the office covers, in words
circle_rate_commercial_to_residential_by.rows_with_both_uses: rows on the office's circle-rate table that list both a commercial and a residential rate
circle_rate_commercial_to_residential_by.median_commercial_over_residential: the middle value of commercial rate divided by residential rate on those rows

circle_rate_jul2026_step_by_office.csv.office: sub-registrar office (the government registration office for the area)
circle_rate_jul2026_step_by_office.csv.colony_categories: number of colony rates sampled in that office and use
circle_rate_jul2026_step_by_office.csv.median_step_pct: the middle rise in the circle rate at the July 2026 revision, in percent

circle_rate_road_ladder.csv.road_band: width of the road the plot faces
circle_rate_road_ladder.csv.median_ratio_to_40ft: how many times the rate for a road up to 40 ft wide the table sets for this road width (middle value)
circle_rate_road_ladder.csv.share_at_median: share of rows that use exactly that multiple (0 to 1)
circle_rate_road_ladder.csv.rows: rows on the circle-rate table for this use and road width

commercial_premium_by_period.csv.auctions: residential and commercial plots sold at JDA's auctions in those years, in schemes that sold both
commercial_premium_by_period.csv.schemes: JDA schemes that sold both residential and commercial plots in those years
commercial_premium_by_period.csv.commercial_premium_pct: how much more per sq m a commercial plot fetched than a residential one in the same scheme, in percent
commercial_premium_by_period.csv.ci_95: range that very probably contains the true premium (95 times in 100)

jda_dispersion_by_period.csv.cells: groups of 5 or more plots of one use sold in one scheme in one year
jda_dispersion_by_period.csv.median_sd: typical spread of winning rates inside a group after allowing for size and corner (log scale; 0.1 is about 10%)
jda_dispersion_by_period.csv.median_p90p10: in the typical group, the dearest tenth of plots' rate divided by the cheapest tenth's
jda_dispersion_by_period.csv.median_iqr_res: in the typical group, the spread of the middle half of plots after size and corner (log scale)
jda_dispersion_by_period.csv.implied_pm_80pct: the band, in percent either way, that holds 8 in 10 plots of a group around its usual rate

jda_holdout_2026.csv.variant: how the 2026 rates were predicted from earlier years only
jda_holdout_2026.csv.mdape_pct: typical size of the miss: the middle value of how far each prediction was from the actual rate, in percent
jda_holdout_2026.csv.within20_pct: share of plots predicted within 20% of the actual rate, in percent
jda_holdout_2026.csv.rmse_log: average size of the misses on a log scale (larger means bigger misses)
jda_holdout_2026.csv.oos_r2: share of the differences between plots' rates that the prediction got right (1 is perfect, 0 is no better than one average)
jda_holdout_2026.csv.bias_median_pct: whether predictions ran high or low on the whole: the middle value of actual over predicted, less one, in percent
jda_holdout_2026.csv.pi80_cover_pct: share of plots that fell inside the prediction's own 8-in-10 band, in percent
jda_holdout_2026.csv.pi80_halfwidth_pct: width of that band either way, in percent
jda_holdout_2026.csv.err_p10_pct: the actual rate was below the prediction by at least this much for 1 plot in 10, in percent
jda_holdout_2026.csv.err_p90_pct: the actual rate was above the prediction by at least this much for 1 plot in 10, in percent
jda_holdout_2026.csv.mdape_seen: typical size of the miss for plots in schemes that had sold before
jda_holdout_2026.csv.mdape_unseen: typical size of the miss for plots in schemes selling for the first time

jda_scheme_life_cycle.csv.comparison: which plots are compared with which
jda_scheme_life_cycle.csv.plots_compared: the stage of a scheme's sales compared
jda_scheme_life_cycle.csv.vs_36m_plus_pct: how much more or less per sq m those plots fetched, in percent
jda_scheme_life_cycle.csv.lo: low end of the range that very probably contains the true figure (95 times in 100)
jda_scheme_life_cycle.csv.p: how often a difference this large would turn up by chance if there were none (0 to 1; small means unlikely)

jda_size_bands_by_use.csv.vs_100_150_pct: how much more or less per sq m plots of this size fetched than plots of 100-150 sq m in the same scheme and year, in percent
jda_size_bands_by_use.csv.lo95_pct: low end of the range that very probably contains the true figure (95 times in 100)
jda_size_bands_by_use.csv.p: how often a difference this large would turn up by chance if there were none (0 to 1; small means unlikely)
jda_size_bands_by_use.csv.n: plots of this use in the comparison

jda_zone_2025_volume_price.csv.g: change in the price of comparable plots from 2024 to 2025 (log scale; 0.1 is about 10%)
jda_zone_2025_volume_price.csv.dlv: change in the number of land auctions JDA listed in the zone from 2024 to 2025 (log scale)
jda_zone_2025_volume_price.csv.vol: land auctions listed in the zone in 2025
jda_zone_2025_volume_price.csv.vol_prev: land auctions listed in the zone in 2024
jda_zone_2025_volume_price.csv.schemes_both: schemes in the zone that sold plots in both years
jda_zone_2025_volume_price.csv.n_pair: plots in those schemes, both years together
jda_zone_2025_volume_price.csv.vol_change_pct: the change in auctions listed, in percent

land_change_2019_2025_by_method.csv.method: the way the change in land prices at JDA's auctions was measured
land_change_2019_2025_by_method.csv.land_2019_2025_pct: change in land prices from 2019 to 2025 by that method, in percent

land_index_by_use_2019_2026.csv.index_2019_100: price level of comparable plots, with 2019 set at 100
land_index_by_use_2019_2026.csv.boot_lo: low end of the range from re-running the sum many times, each with a different random pick of schemes
land_index_by_use_2019_2026.csv.boot_valid: how many of those re-runs gave an answer

land_index_by_year_and_method.csv.index_auctions: plots sold that year that enter the price measures
land_index_by_year_and_method.csv.plain_median_inr_per_sqm: the middle winning rate that year, in rupees per sq m
land_index_by_year_and_method.csv.plain_median_2010_100: that middle rate as a level, with 2010 set at 100
land_index_by_year_and_method.csv.within_zones_2010_100: price level comparing plots within the same JDA zone, 2010 = 100
land_index_by_year_and_method.csv.stratified_median_2010_100: price level from middle rates of plots of the same zone and use, 2010 = 100
land_index_by_year_and_method.csv.within_schemes_2010_100: price level comparing plots only within the same scheme, 2010 = 100
land_index_by_year_and_method.csv.nhb_residex_calendar_mean: NHB RESIDEX, the national housing bank's index of bank valuations of homes, average of the year's quarters

price_measures_compared.csv.what_it_measures: what that figure is a price of
price_measures_compared.csv.window: the period its change covers, as the publisher states it
price_measures_compared.csv.note: where it comes from, or a caution
price_measures_compared.csv.in_pack: whether the proof-of-work pack shows it

registrations_month_effects.csv.state_vs_april_pct: sale deeds registered in this month against April, across Rajasthan's districts, in percent
registrations_month_effects.csv.state_lo95: low end of the range that very probably contains the true figure (95 times in 100)
registrations_month_effects.csv.jaipur_minus_state_pct: how far Jaipur's pattern for this month differs from the state's, in percentage points
registrations_month_effects.csv.jaipur_vs_april_pct: sale deeds registered in Jaipur in this month against April, in percent

rera_jaipur_registrations_by_type_and_ye.year: year the project was registered with RERA
rera_jaipur_registrations_by_type_and_ye.plotted: plotted projects (plots, not flats) registered in Jaipur district
rera_jaipur_registrations_by_type_and_ye.plotted_read_twice: whether that count read the same on 13 and 14 November 2026
rera_jaipur_registrations_by_type_and_ye.group_housing_read_twice: whether that count read the same on both days
rera_jaipur_registrations_by_type_and_ye.commercial_read_twice: whether that count read the same on both days
rera_jaipur_registrations_by_type_and_ye.mixed_read_twice: whether that count read the same on both days
rera_jaipur_registrations_by_type_and_ye.total: all projects registered in Jaipur district that year
rera_jaipur_registrations_by_type_and_ye.state_total: all projects registered in Rajasthan that year

rera_plotted_share_wilson.csv.area: Jaipur district or the rest of Rajasthan
rera_plotted_share_wilson.csv.share_pct: plotted projects as a share of all, in percent
rera_plotted_share_wilson.csv.lo: low end of the range that very probably contains the true figure (95 times in 100)

residential_plot_size_bands.csv.band: plot size, in sq m (an older cut, against 100-200 sq m; jda_size_bands_by_use.csv is the newer table)
residential_plot_size_bands.csv.vs_100_200_pct: how much more or less per sq m they fetched than plots of 100-200 sq m in the same scheme, in percent
residential_plot_size_bands.csv.ci_lo: low end of the range that very probably contains the true figure (95 times in 100)

transaction_cost_inputs.csv.value: the rate (percent, or rupees for the threshold and the example value)
transaction_cost_inputs.csv.checked: how and when the notification was read

zone9_index_by_year.csv.index_2021_100: price level of comparable plots in JDA zone 9, with 2021 set at 100
zone9_index_by_year.csv.schemes: zone 9 schemes that sold plots that year
zone9_index_by_year.csv.boot_lo: low end of the range from re-running the sum many times, each with a different random pick of schemes
zone9_index_by_year.csv.boot_valid: how many of those re-runs gave an answer
